notes.title: PsychoFlux Ent. 4th Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6188768/efab4791c242911d7fb384c5bab6381370169683.png[/img]

On [b]March 26th[/b] 2020, we have reached our [b]4th anniversary[/b] milestone. In the recent days we have finally begun to produce good results, but there's still much to be done. Thank you for everyone's continuous support.

To celebrate our anniversary, we're holding a special promotion! Get the games we're publishing at a discounted price this weekend.

The discount rate goes up to [b]75%[/b], and has been applied to most of our games on Steam. The offer ends around [b]March 30th and 31st[/b], so don't miss the chance!

Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/PsychoFlux]publisher page on Steam[/url] to find out which games are on sale.
